_comment: Word loc -> Konsep library ids that the word illustrates; feeds Word.concepts in schema.ts. Same format as al-fatihah.concepts-map.json. Every record is status draft as pipeline state; there is no human review step (plan L11). Existing ids are from belajar/content/library.json; NEW ids (maqul-al-qaul, dhamir-syan, khabar-jumlah, jazm-lam, fiil-majhul, kana-wa-akhawatuha) are proposed in al-ikhlas.new-concepts.md with their sources. validate.py requires every loc listed here to appear in that concept's `examples` and vice versa, so the integrator must add each pair below to library.concepts.json (al-ikhlas.new-concepts.md gives a sourced example note for every pair). Ids are listed in the order the concepts appear in library.concepts.json, new ids last.
